status: PROPOSAL - thresholds set on one document family (5 documents); generalisation NOT EVALUATED

word_recall_min.unit: fraction of PDF word tokens (after furniture exclusion) found in the K1 page text

numeric_recall_min.unit: fraction of PDF numeric tokens (after furniture exclusion) found in the K1 page text

numeric_novel_max.unit: count of K1 numeric tokens that do not occur anywhere on the PDF page; a count above this value warns

min_page_words.unit: PDF word tokens needed on a page before word recall is judged

empty_page_min_words.unit: PDF word tokens on a page that make an empty K1 page a warning

margin_band.unit: fraction of page height at top and bottom searched for repeated lines (same value as the pipeline filter margin_band)

frequency.unit: fraction of pages of a document on which a margin line (digits masked) must appear to count as furniture

min_pages.unit: pages a document needs before repeated margin lines are used

max_listed_tokens.unit: missing/novel tokens copied into signal evidence per category
